ThePaymaster® Pre-Qualification

Welcome to ThePaymaster®

ThePaymaster® is a registered trademark providing introduction services for high-value clients seeking access to the Wraith Global Partners (WGP) Family Office and their proprietary programmes.

We do not offer financial advice or manage investments. Our role is to help you prepare for an introduction to WGP, ensuring you are ready for their onboarding process and exclusive tools.

How it works:

Before we can introduce you to WGP, you’ll need to meet certain documentation and information requirements. To make this as straightforward as possible, we’ve created a Pre-Qualification Aid. This tool will guide you through what you’ll need to prepare, based on your circumstances. It is for your information only—no data is collected or stored.

Ready to begin?
